message.content: {"results": [{"n": "G1", "evidence": "Screenshots 1–5 show the 3D bamboo scene rendering cleanly in Chrome with no errors or blank screen.", "pass": true}, {"n": "G2", "evidence": "OrbitControls sets maxDistance to 45 without setting maxPolarAngle, allowing the camera to orbit outside the grove into a white void (screenshot 5) and go below the ground plane.", "pass": false}, {"n": "G3", "evidence": "The scene uses two instanced meshes (340 stalks and 3,400 leaf planes), one 2048x2048 shadow map, and an UnrealBloomPass, which will easily run above 30 fps on a standard laptop.", "pass": true}, {"n": "1", "evidence": "Screenshots 1–5 display a persistent bottom-left UI bar with instructions and three interactive buttons ('Match Photo Angle', 'Ground Walk View', 'Wind: ON').", "pass": false}, {"n": "2", "evidence": "In the animate() loop, windUniforms.uTime updates automatically from load with windOn = true, driving vertex-shader wind sway on stalks and leaves.", "pass": true}, {"n": "3", "evidence": "Screenshot 1 matches the reference photo's steep upward wide-angle framing with converging foreground bamboo culms and a dark overhanging tree branch in the upper left.", "pass": true}, {"n": "4", "evidence": "Screenshots 1–3 show dense spacing of foreground and background bamboo stalks that closely matches the density in the reference photo.", "pass": true}, {"n": "5", "evidence": "While leaves and stalks use yellow-green and deep green hues, overwhelming white bloom/haze washes out the palette in screenshots 1–3, losing the rich deep shadows and crisp greens of the photo.", "pass": false}, {"n": "6", "evidence": "The reference photo looks straight up into the canopy and contains no ground elements like a path or brushwood fence, nor are any present in the scene's flat CircleGeometry ground.", "pass": false}, {"n": "7", "evidence": "Screenshot 1 matches the bright, blown-out overhead sky illumination filtering down from directly above as seen in the reference photo, though with heavier bloom.", "pass": true}, {"n": "8", "evidence": "Screenshots 1–3 clearly show dark horizontal node rings and slight geometric bulges at regular intervals along the bamboo stalks.", "pass": true}, {"n": "9", "evidence": "Screenshot 1 and the instancing loop (`scaleR = 0.68 + Math.random() * 0.55`, `scaleY = 0.82 + Math.random() * 0.32`) show varied stalk thicknesses and heights.", "pass": true}, {"n": "10", "evidence": "Screenshots 1–3 and the per-instance random tilt/curve logic show stalks leaning and bowing at varied natural angles rather than standing on a vertical grid.", "pass": true}, {"n": "11", "evidence": "Screenshot 4 clearly shows the canopy built from clusters of thin, narrow lanceolate leaves on small stems.", "pass": true}, {"n": "12", "evidence": "In section 9 of the code (`new THREE.CircleGeometry(45, 48)` with solid `color: 0x1a2616`), the ground is just a flat, untextured dark green circular plane with no soil or fallen leaves.", "pass": false}, {"n": "13", "evidence": "Screenshot 5 shows the entire circular grove patch floating inside an empty white sky sphere with clear outer edges when zoomed out.", "pass": false}, {"n": "14", "evidence": "Screenshots 1–3 show smooth, washed-out lighting with bright vertical specular streaks on the stalks rather than dappled sunlight patches on somewhat overpowering.", "pass": true}, {"n": "16", "evidence": "In screenshots 1–3, the canopy leaves appear flatly shaded and washed out by white haze rather than convincingly glowing with transmitted backlight.", "pass": false}, {"n": "17", "evidence": "Screenshots 1–4 show that shaded areas between stalks retain green tonal detail and never crush to pure black.", "pass": true}, {"n": "18", "evidence": "In screenshots 1–3, the stalks exhibit a strong plastic-like vertical white highlight and uniform repeating green bands rather than realistic natural yellowing or organic stains.", "pass": false}, {"n": "19", "evidence": "Screenshot 4 shows completely opaque, flatly lit green leaf cutouts (`alphaTest: 0.32` with uniform emissive) lacking realistic translucency.", "pass": false}, {"n": "20", "evidence": "The ground mesh (`MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x1a2616 })`) is a plain solid-colored circle with no texture or geometry that could read as real soil, leaves, or stone.", "pass": false}, {"n": "21", "evidence": "Because the camera looks sharply upward (`camera.position.set(0, 1.35, 2.9)`, `target.set(0.35, 14.5, -1.2)`) with default up-vector `(0,1,0)`, the horizon is unrolled with no unintended Dutch tilt, matching the photo's upward perspective convergence.", "pass": true}, {"n": "22", "evidence": "In `leafMat.onBeforeCompile`, `canopySway` and `flutter` displace adjacent stalks.", "pass": false}, {"n": "28", "evidence": "There is no LOD switching, frustum-dependent instancing, or overlapping coplanar geometry in the code, and screenshots 1–4 show no pop-in or
